title: kLOsk/adloop
summary: Discover accounts and inspect aggregate product and account issues; feed health may trigger developer registration.
method: Runtime FastMCP provider registry inspection; independently re-extracted, with no handlers called.

tools.name: list_merchant_accounts
tools.description:
List Google Merchant Center accounts the connected user can access.

Returns each account's numeric ID, name and whether it is a test
account. Provides the account_id used by get_merchant_feed_health;
not needed when merchant.account_id is set in the config.

Merchant API: https://developers.google.com/merchant/api/overview
tools.summary: List Google Merchant Center accounts the connected user can access.
tools.availability: Registered by default; ADLOOP_TOOLSETS filters by toolset while core survives. Hosted runtimes can further filter.

tools.name: get_merchant_feed_health
tools.description:
Merchant Center feed health — disapproved products + account issues.

Disapproved feed items silently starve Shopping and Performance Max
campaigns; this reports approved/pending/disapproved counts per
reporting context (Shopping ads, free listings, ...), the top product
issues by affected products (with documentation links), and
account-level issues — CRITICAL ones stop offers serving entirely.
Product-status data lags reality by ~30 minutes.

Merchant API: https://developers.google.com/merchant/api/overview

account_id.description:
Numeric Merchant Center ID from list_merchant_accounts.
Defaults to merchant.account_id in the config.

tools.summary: Merchant Center feed health — disapproved products + account issues.
notes: Despite its upstream readOnlyHint, this tool automatically POSTs developer registration when the project is not registered.
Account issues and aggregate statuses are not paginated. Summed totals cover reporting contexts and countries, so they are not a unique-product count.
tools.availability: Registered by default; ADLOOP_TOOLSETS filters by toolset while core survives. Hosted runtimes can further filter.

notes: Only Merchant Center tools are included. The shared health_check probes other services and is omitted.
ADLOOP_TOOLSETS can filter the advertised tools; these definitions use the full default registry.
